proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _ N hN hne hmin
  haveI := hN
  have hc : ⁅N, N⁆ = ⊥ := by
    rcases hmin ⁅N, N⁆ inferInstance ((Subgroup.commutator_le_inf N N).trans inf_le_left) with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (isSolvable_def G).1 (inferInstance : IsSolvable G)
      have key : ∀ i, N ≤ derivedSeries G i := by
        intro i
        induction i with
        | zero => exact le_top
        | succ i ih => exact h.ge.trans (Subgroup.commutator_mono ih ih)
      exact hne (le_bot_iff.1 (hm ▸ key m))
  intro a ha b hb
  have := Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator ha hb
  rw [hc, Subgroup.mem_bot] at this
  exact commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_mul_comm.1 this
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [IsSolvable G] (N : Subgroup G), N.Normal → N ≠ ⊥ → (∀ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal → K ≤ N → K = ⊥ ∨ K = N) → ∀ a ∈ N, ∀ b ∈ N, a * b = b * a
